description: This file defines template classes for key-value pairs, including a generic KeyValueType and a specialized TextKeyValueType with case sensitivity options. It provides mechanisms for storing, comparing, and accessing key-value data, primarily used within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: KeyValueType
classes.description: A template class representing a key-value pair with comparison and access methods.

classes.name: TextKeyValueType
classes.description: A specialized template class for text-based key-value pairs with case sensitivity control.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying key-value pairs.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison between two key-value pairs.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison between two key-value pairs.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns a reference to the key component.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns a reference to the value component.

methods.name: IsKey
methods.description: Checks if a given key matches the stored key.

methods.name: HasKey
methods.description: Checks if the TextFragment key is non-empty.

methods.name: IsKey
methods.description: Checks if a given TextFragment key matches the stored key, considering case sensitivity.
